dialogue.name: Godavari
dialogue.text:
I like it when my days are dull. Because my mind never is.
He had it coming, but those poor cops make my heart swell.

dialogue.name: Godavari
dialogue.text:
Maybe they will learn someday, that I’m no simple snack.
I am a woman with good plans and the best of bloody intentions.

dialogue.name: Godavari
dialogue.text:
It's been good, while it lasted.
See you next page.
